name: Méra (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red, green and blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Méra: a crowned blue and green shield with a figure and a white horse, between ears of grain, above a scroll inscribed MÉRA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
